nodes.label: Streaming Polars CSV Processing Pattern
nodes.rationale: Streams multi-gigabyte SICOR CSV files in bounded chunks via pl.scan_csv(infer_schema_length=0, low_memory=True) and collect_batches(engine='streaming'), paired with 64 KiB header delimiter sniffing and 1 MiB incremental UTF-8 transcoding for cp1252/Latin-1 fallback without exhausting RAM or corrupting string identifiers.

nodes.label: Automatic SIRGAS 2000 UTM Zone Selection Rationale
nodes.rationale: Inspects Camada Base GeoPackage bounding-box metadata via pyogrio.read_info, transforms bounds to WGS84 to locate the centroid, and queries EPSG projected CRSs for the matching 'SIRGAS 2000 / UTM zone {zone}{S|N}' so hectare area calculations are metrically accurate without manual CRS input.
nodes.norm_label: automatic sirgas 2000 utm zone selection rationale

nodes.label: Spatial Index & Union Overlap Deduplication Rationale
nodes.rationale: Uses GeoPandas spatial index (sjoin intersects) to prune candidate plot-polygon pairs, then unions all intersecting Camada Base polygons per plot via shapely.union_all before computing .area and clamping to total plot area so overlapping base-layer polygons are never double-counted.
nodes.norm_label: spatial index & union overlap deduplication rationale

nodes.label: Incremental MultipartReader for <=10 GiB Uploads
nodes.rationale: Custom streaming MultipartReader scans multipart/form-data boundaries in 64 KiB chunks and writes uploaded CSV/GeoPackage parts directly to disk without buffering multi-gigabyte uploads (up to 10 GiB) in RAM, enforcing filename sanitization, duplicate detection, and extension allowlists.

nodes.label: SQLite-Backed Paginated Dashboard & Map Architecture
nodes.rationale: Materializes joined overlap records, indexed filter columns (MUNICIPIO, UF, ANO, CNPJ_IF), and pre-projected WGS84 GeoJSON polygons into per-job SQLite tables (dashboard_rows, map_plots, map_lands, map_plot_lands) to support fast server-side pagination (25/50/100), <=500-feature map slicing, deduplicated credit/area summaries, and filtered Excel exports.

nodes.label: Single-Active-Job Concurrency & Local Origin Isolation
nodes.rationale: Serializes heavy geospatial analyses via _active_job_lock (returning HTTP 409 if busy), validates localhost Host/Origin headers, and deletes raw uploads immediately in finally to prevent memory/disk exhaustion on local workstations.

nodes.label: Chunked Polars + Spatial Index Overlap Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Uses Polars column projection and lazy/streaming chunked execution (--tamanho-bloco), Shapely WKT parsing, geopandas.sjoin() spatial indexing, per-table financed sums prior to consolidation, and case-insensitive column stacking with ARQUIVO_OPERACOES/ARQUIVO_GLEBAS to avoid memory spikes and Cartesian joins while enforcing Excel's 1,048,576-row limit and UTF-8 chunked transcoding (cp1252/latin1 fallback).
nodes.norm_label: chunked polars + spatial index overlap pipeline

nodes.label: Automatic SIRGAS 2000 UTM CRS Selection (--crs-area auto)
nodes.rationale: Defaults source WKT coordinates to EPSG:4674 and inspects the Camada Base spatial extent center to automatically select the matching SIRGAS 2000 UTM zone (e.g., EPSG:31980 for zone 20S) for accurate hectare calculations while warning about potential distortion across multi-zone extents.
nodes.norm_label: automatic sirgas 2000 utm crs selection (--crs-area auto)

nodes.rationale: Parent institutional corporate identity represented by logo_bb.png, supplying the institutional blue/yellow palette, BancoDoBrasilTextos typography, and the geometric chevron motif integrated into geo.png.

nodes.label: Microsoft Power BI
nodes.rationale: Microsoft Power BI analytics and dashboard visualization brand represented by the ascending yellow/amber three-bar icon in image/powerbi_logo.png.

nodes.label: DIRAG/GERAG
nodes.rationale: Banco do Brasil organizational unit explicitly credited beneath 'PLATAFORMA GEO e INOVAÇÃO' in image/geo.png.

nodes.label: InfoGEO
nodes.rationale: Geospatial information brand/module encompassing both the black-framed geometric land-mosaic badge (image/infogeo.png) and the rural aerial landscape illustration (image/infogeo_img.png and duplicate image/infogeo_old.png).

nodes.label: Paleta Institucional BB / Plataforma Geo
nodes.rationale: Visual color system uniting Banco do Brasil institutional blue (#262DA7) and highlight yellow (#FAFD00) with environmental green (#01781E), sky blue (#74D5F8), and turquoise (#6DDECF) — shared across logo_bb.png, geo.png, and guia_estilo.md.

nodes.label: Simbolismo Agro-Ambiental e Geotecnologia
nodes.rationale: Recurring visual theme across the image assets uniting rural land-use and environmental features (leafy tree, riparian forest, crop plots, pasture) with computational and geospatial abstraction (PCB circuit traces in geo.png, territorial mosaic in infogeo.png).

nodes.label: infogeo_old.png — Legacy InfoGEO Rural Aerial Landscape
nodes.rationale: Legacy InfoGEO-era square (1:1) aerial photographic-style illustration (stored as JPEG bytes with .png extension). Depicts four adjacent rural land-cover zones under a clear blue sky: a winding dark-blue river flanked by dense green riparian forest, a geometric green row-crop field bordered by dirt tracks, fenced green pasture with scattered trees and grazing cattle, and contoured reddish-brown plowed soil. Visually identical to image/infogeo_img.png and unused by interface.html.
nodes.norm_label: infogeo_old.png — legacy infogeo rural aerial landscape

nodes.label: background.png — Current AgTech Cyber-Tree Hero Background
nodes.rationale: Refined PNG (~5:4) background banner for Plataforma Geo e Inovação. Depicts converging rows of green soybean crops illuminated by glowing golden-copper PCB circuit traces along the soil furrows, a 3D bronze split cyber-tree emblem (left half electronic circuits, right half organic leaves) shifted left-of-center, vivid blue sky with soft upper cloud diffusion, and a translucent white mist fade along the bottom edge for smooth layering under light UI panels. Currently unreferenced in interface.html, which uses a flat #f4f6f8 canvas.
nodes.norm_label: background.png — current agtech cyber-tree hero background

nodes.label: background_old.png — Legacy Widescreen Cyber-Tree Background
nodes.rationale: Original widescreen (16:9) version of the AgTech cyber-tree background (stored as JPEG bytes with .png extension), superseded by image/background.png. Shows the same 3D bronze half-circuit/half-leaf tree and glowing copper PCB traces along converging soybean furrows, but with the tree closer to center, darker high-contrast foreground soil, minimal clouds, and a sharp unblended bottom edge without white mist fade.

nodes.label: Cyber-Tree Emblem (Half-Circuit, Half-Leaf)
nodes.rationale: Visual brand motif uniting digital/geospatial innovation (angular circuit traces and terminal nodes on the left canopy) with agriculture and environmental sustainability (organic leaves on the right canopy), rendered in 3D bronze in background.png/background_old.png and mirrored as the flat green logo mark in image/geo.png.

nodes.label: Digital Agriculture Circuit-Furrow Motif
nodes.rationale: AgTech spatial monitoring metaphor embedding glowing copper PCB traces directly along converging green crop rows under an expansive blue sky, linking precision farming with geospatial analytics.

nodes.label: UI Light-Canvas Bottom Fade Treatment
nodes.rationale: Visual refinement transforming background_old.png (16:9, sharp dark bottom edge, centered emblem) into background.png (~5:4, left-shifted emblem, softened sky clouds, white gradient mist along the bottom) so white/light UI cards (#ffffff / #f4f6f8) can overlay cleanly.

nodes.label: Multi-Use Rural Land Cover Landscape Motif
nodes.rationale: Photorealistic aerial composition illustrating coexisting rural land-use classes—riparian forest beside a river, cultivated row crops, cattle pasture, and contoured bare soil—corresponding to geospatial plot (gleba) and environmental base-layer overlap analysis.
nodes.norm_label: multi-use rural land cover landscape motif

nodes.label: Legacy InfoGEO Visual Identity Era
nodes.rationale: Earlier project branding phase preceding Plataforma Geo e Inovação, spanning both the labeled GIS pixel-mosaic icon (image/infogeo.png) and photorealistic rural aerial scene (image/infogeo_old.png / image/infogeo_img.png) before transitioning to the cyber-tree AgTech motif and ultimately the flat institutional CSS system.

nodes.label: Consulta Feature Card Artwork (CAR / SIGEF / INCRA Aerial Parcel & GIS Stack)
nodes.rationale: Feature card illustration combining an oblique aerial riverside farm parcel outlined in white with a central map pin, stacked CAR/SIGEF/INCRA layer pills, and an isometric 3-layer GIS stack (orthophoto, choropleth zoning, vector hydrography/roads) to represent unified cadastral querying.
nodes.norm_label: consulta feature card artwork (car / sigef / incra aerial parcel & gis stack)

nodes.label: Multi-Layer Cadastral Query (CAR, SIGEF, INCRA)
nodes.rationale: Aggregates environmental registry (CAR), certified geodetic boundaries (SIGEF), and agrarian tenure data (INCRA) onto a single target parcel for cross-registry verification.

nodes.label: Isometric 3-Layer GIS Overlay Stack
nodes.rationale: Visualizes multi-source spatial data fusion by stacking satellite orthophoto imagery, thematic land-use zoning, and vector hydrography/road base maps.

nodes.label: Ferramentas Feature Card Icon (Gears, Calculator, Tractors & Crops)
nodes.rationale: Rounded-square graphic icon card on a cyan-to-teal gradient blending faint circuit-board traces and crop fields with white paper-cut concentric gears, a calculator icon (+/-/=/up-arrow), agricultural tractors, and green leaves/wheat to signify automated agro-computational utilities.
nodes.norm_label: ferramentas feature card icon (gears, calculator, tractors & crops)

nodes.label: Agro-Computational & Operational Analysis Tools
nodes.rationale: Integrates computational automation (gears and circuitry), quantitative metrics calculation (calculator with growth arrow), and mechanized agricultural workflows (tractors and crops) into a platform toolset.

nodes.label: Satélite Feature Card Artwork (Orbital Multispectral Crop Scan)
nodes.rationale: Feature card illustration depicting an Earth-observation satellite with solar panels above Earth's curved horizon projecting a rainbow multispectral scanning cone onto patchwork agricultural fields and a river.
nodes.norm_label: satelite feature card artwork (orbital multispectral crop scan)

nodes.label: Multispectral Satellite Remote Sensing
nodes.rationale: Applies orbital multi-band optical imaging over crop mosaics, soils, and riparian zones for continuous land-cover classification and agricultural monitoring.

nodes.label: Valoração Feature Card Artwork (Aerial Rural Estate with $ Geolocation Pin)
nodes.rationale: Feature card illustration showing a sunlit green rural property with row crops, pastures, farmhouse, and forested riparian river corridor overlaid with a prominent white '$' geolocation pin to depict georeferenced rural land valuation.
nodes.norm_label: valoracao feature card artwork (aerial rural estate with $ geolocation pin)

nodes.label: Georeferenced Rural Property Valuation
nodes.rationale: Links parcel geolocation, productive agricultural attributes (pastures and row crops), and riparian conservation context to economic appraisal of rural assets.

nodes.label: Parecer Geo Feature Card Emblem (PARECER TÉCNICO GEO Seal & Topographic Compass)
nodes.rationale: Cobalt-blue square graphic emblem centering a topographic contour compass rose ('N'), an official 'PARECER TÉCNICO GEO' document with structured tables, a green scalloped checkmark approval seal, and a gold-accented pen.
nodes.norm_label: parecer geo feature card emblem (parecer tecnico geo seal & topographic compass)

nodes.label: Certified Technical Geospatial Opinion (Parecer Técnico Geo)
nodes.rationale: Consolidates topographic cartography and tabular spatial checks into an audit-ready, validated technical geospatial compliance opinion.
nodes.norm_label: certified technical geospatial opinion (parecer tecnico geo)

nodes.label: Busca CAR Feature Card Artwork (Magnifying Glass Over Overlapping CAR Polygons)
nodes.rationale: Top-down illustrated rural cartographic map with compass rose and illustrative Brazilian rural toponyms (Fazenda Boa Vista, Sítio São Pedro, Córrego do Lageado, Estrada do Retiro, Fazenda Santa Clara, Sítio Recanto Verde, Morro do Cedro) where a magnifying glass highlights multiple overlapping, offset colored boundary polygons to depict CAR search and overlap diagnosis.
nodes.norm_label: busca car feature card artwork (magnifying glass over overlapping car polygons)

nodes.label: CAR Parcel Search & Multi-Polygon Overlap Inspection
nodes.rationale: Supports spatial querying of Rural Environmental Registry (CAR) boundaries and visual identification of multi-polygon overlaps or geometry discrepancies.
nodes.norm_label: car parcel search & multi-polygon overlap inspection
